name: ballerinax/ai.pgvector
description: Pgvector is a PostgreSQL extension that introduces a vector data type and similarity search capabilities for working with embeddings.

fields.name: embeddingType
fields.description: Type of the embedding to be used

fields.name: similarityMetric
fields.description: Similarity metric to be used for the similarity search

typeDefs.name: SimilarityMetric
typeDefs.description: Similarity metric to be used for the similarity search

typeDefs.name: VectorStore
typeDefs.description: Initializes the pgvector vector store with the provided configuration.

functions.name: init
functions.description: Initializes the pgvector vector store with the provided configuration.

parameters.name: host
parameters.description: The host name of the database

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port number of the database

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Additional set of configurations for the database

parameters.name: configs
parameters.description: Contains configuration for database connections and other necessary parameters

functions.name: add
functions.description: Adds vector entries to the vector store database.

parameters.name: entries
parameters.description: Array of vector entries to be added

return.description: Returns an `ai:Error` if the operation fails, otherwise returns nil

functions.name: delete
functions.description: Deletes vector entries from the vector store database by ID(s).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Single ID or array of IDs to delete

return.description: Returns an `ai:Error` if the operation fails, otherwise returns nil

functions.name: query
functions.description: Queries the vector store for matches to the given query embedding and filters.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The vector store query containing embedding and optional filters

return.description: Returns an array of `ai:VectorMatch` results or an `ai:Error` if the operation fails
